PRECAUTIONS
The tip of the thistle funnel should be dipped into the solution.
I. The apparatus should be airtight. All the glasswares should be handled with care.
The edge of the delivery tube should be cut smoothly and it should not be dipped into the solution.

Note: Instead of dilute hydrochloric acid, sulphuric acid and nitric acid cannot be used. On using sulphuric acid, insoluble calcium sulphate is formed whicll covers the marble pieces and keeps the marble pieces out of contact of sulphuric acid. In case of nitric acid, along with C02 other gas is also evolved since HN03 is an oxidising agent.
Powdered CaC03 also cannot be used in the preparation of C02 gas because the reaction is too fast.

THEORY

PROCESS

Take a glass tube and bend it at right angle. Take a clean round bottom flask. To this flask put the mixture of ammonium chloride and slaked lime in 1:2 ratio by weight. Add few drops of water to make the mixture into paste. Fit the apparatus as shown in figure and make it airtight. Then heat the mixture and collect the ammonia gas by downward displacement of air.
